_what: OG-06 §3.4 per-UNIT price table (CLAUDE.md §23): what an image, a character of speech, a second of audio or a rerank search unit costs, per (provider, model). Read by crates/gateway/src/unit_pricing.rs (include_str!, parsed once). A model with NO entry here is UNPRICED: the span carries the unit and a null cost, counted as unpriced — never 0. Add a row only with a vendor price page that says the number; do not infer one.
_sources_note: Every entry carries its own `source` and the date it was read. Rechecked the existing unit rates and OpenAI Batch multiplier on 2026-10-08. Image generation is deliberately EMPTY: OpenAI prices gpt-image models per token and says 'use the calculator in the image generation guide' (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing, 2026-10-08); no Cohere rerank rate was newly verified in this refresh.

batch._what: The Batch API's multiplier on the synchronous list price, applied when a completed batch's token usage is priced (spec OG-06 §3.2). OpenAI's official Batch guide states a 50% discount (https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/batch, verified 2026-10-08). Change it here if OpenAI says otherwise.
